main.description: A requester submits an RFP to a bidder. The bidder records a bid intent and answers before it bids. Requires a service-auth JWT with lxm set to this NSID; the requester is the token issuer.

ingress.description: The com.publicdomainrelay.temp.ingress.webRTC offer records for this bidder. The bidder answers them in the reply with its own answer and listen records.

name.description: The bid intent the bidder recorded.

phase.description: The phase of the bid intent.

ingress.description: The bidder's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.ingress.webRTC answer and listen records for the request's offers, carrying the SDP and the bidder's STUN servers.
